title: ChatGPT’s Chat tab: GPT-6 against the new GPT-6.2
intro: Switch between the old and new model behind ChatGPT’s Chat tab to see the scores OpenAI published for each. Higher is better on every line.
note: All figures are from OpenAI’s own tests, as written in its 23 November release notes; no outside group has checked them. The expert-task score is at the lowest reasoning setting OpenAI tested, and the web-search score is an internal version of BrowseComp at the Extra high setting. The safety line is the share of responses that met OpenAI’s policies in challenging conversations. The Work and Codex models are not part of this change.
